text: DSH Browser Bridge 是一款面向 DSH Desktop 的浏览器工具插件：它把 Microsoft Edge 中已经登录的标签页接入 DSH。插件在 DSH 注册 browser_* 原生工具，并通过本机桥接服务和 Edge 扩展读取页面文字与结构化快照、返回截图，也能点击、输入、导航和管理标签页。每项操作都使用明确的标签句柄，DSH 会按 Agent/Session 管理标签归属。适合希望让 DSH 查看并操作现有浏览器页面的用户；需要安装并配对 Edge 扩展，不需要额外 API Key。

DSH Browser Bridge connects signed-in Edge tabs to DSH Desktop through native browser tools, a local bridge, and an Edge extension. It reads page text and snapshots, returns screenshots, and performs browser actions and tab management on explicit tabs. Pair the extension; no API key is required.
想让 DSH 读取我 Edge 里已经登录的网页内容。
能不能让 DSH 帮我点击网页、填写表单并切换页面？
I want my DSH assistant to inspect and interact with tabs in my existing Edge browser.
DSH Browser Bridge 的功能「读取网页」：browser_content 读取文字、标题和网址；browser_snapshot 获取页面结构；browser_screenshot 返回指定标签页截图。
DSH Browser Bridge 的功能「操作与管理标签页」：使用 browser_open 打开并接管页面，之后可导航、点击、输入、滚动、上传或下载，并可列出、释放或关闭指定标签页。操作目标须使用显式标签句柄。
DSH Browser Bridge 使用前须知：页面文字和截图会作为工具结果返回给 DSH 宿主与所选模型处理；截图结果需要模型支持图像。
dsh-browser-bridge 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。
dsh-browser-bridge 提供工具 status：Inspect the local bridge and connected browser instances. Does not claim a tab.
dsh-browser-bridge 提供工具 tabs：List tabs and ownership. Select an instance explicitly when several are connected.
dsh-browser-bridge 提供工具 open：Open a page in this session’s tab group and claim it. Returns its opaque tab handle.
dsh-browser-bridge 提供工具 claim：Explicitly acquire an existing free tab selected from browser_tabs. Never steals another session’s tab.
dsh-browser-bridge 提供工具 session_close：Release every tab owned by this session. Leaves tabs open; use when browser work is complete.

dsh-browser-bridge README · Browser Bridge：让 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 和 Antigravity App** 直接操作日常使用、已经登录的 **Microsoft Edge**。

DSH 通过原生插件调用浏览器工具，Antigravity App 通过 MCP 调用；两端共用本地桥接服务和 Edge 扩展，可读取页面、截图、点击、输入和管理标签页。

dsh-browser-bridge README · 下载与安装：仅使用 DSH 时，也可以从 ZIP 中提取 Edge 扩展，无需安装 Antigravity App 插件。

完成插件和扩展安装后，在解压后的 `browser-bridge` 目录中执行：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\BrowserBridge.ps1 pair
```

将输出的令牌和端口填入 Edge 扩展弹窗。正常只需配对一次；后续调用会按需启动桥接服务。完整步骤、自定义配置和配对故障处理见 [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md)。

**发布状态：** v2.0.3 已构建和打包，未运行自动化测试、逐版本验证或双宿主端到端验收。声明的版本范围不等于每个版本都已经验证。

dsh-browser-bridge README · 可以做什么：- **读取页面：** 正文、结构化快照、真实标签页截图。
- **操作网页：** 点击、悬停、输入、按键、滚动、下拉选择、导航与等待。
- **处理文件与对话框：** 文件上传、工具发起的下载、JavaScript 对话框。
- **管理标签页：** 列举、新建、明确接管、分组、释放与关闭。

27 个统一 `browser_*` 工具复用现有 Edge 的登录状态。截图以图像工具结果返回，所选模型需要支持图像。每次操作都指定标签句柄，不会默认操作当前活动页面。

DSH 按 Agent/Session 分配标签归属；Antigravity 按 MCP 进程分配。共享同一 MCP 进程的聊天不自动获得独立身份。浏览器内部页和原生系统窗口不在操作范围内，其他限制见 [范围与限制](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md#范围与限制)。

dsh-browser-bridge README · 如何连接：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  D[DSH 原生插件] --> B[本地 Browser Bridge]
  A[Antigravity App] --> M[MCP 适配器]
  M --> B

默认监听 `127.0.0.1:9224`。Windows 状态和令牌保存在 `%USERPROFILE%\.browser-bridge`；端口与状态目录可配置。两端使用相同设置即可共享桥接服务。页面内容和截图会交给所用宿主与模型处理。

dsh-browser-bridge README · Browser Bridge：Control your existing, signed-in **Microsoft Edge** tabs from **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** and **Antigravity App**.

DSH registers native browser tools; Antigravity App connects through MCP. Both use the same local bridge and Edge extension for page reading, screenshots, browser actions, and tab management.

dsh-browser-bridge README · Download and install：DSH-only users can extract the Edge extension from the ZIP without installing the Antigravity App plugin. After installing the host plugin and extension, run this command from the extracted `browser-bridge` directory:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\BrowserBridge.ps1 pair
```

dsh-browser-bridge README · Download and install：Enter the returned token and port in the extension popup. Pairing normally persists across restarts, and tool calls start the bridge on demand. See the [full installation guide in Chinese](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md) for configuration and pairing recovery.

dsh-browser-bridge README · Requirements：- **DSH:** `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <=0.2.1 || >=0.2.2-rc.1 <=0.2.2`. This admits subsequent release candidates and the stable release in both version families without listing each version.
- **Node.js:** 22+. Windows scripts prefer the runtime bundled with DSH.
- **Edge:** 125+, with the extension loaded in the browser profile you want to control.
- **Antigravity:** the App with plugin support.

dsh-browser-bridge README · Requirements：The release ZIP includes bundled JavaScript runtime files. Using it does not require Python or installing npm dependencies. DSH uses native tools directly, without agy or an external subagent.

**Release status:** v2.0.3 has been built and packaged. Automated tests, cross-version verification, and end-to-end host acceptance have not been run.

dsh-browser-bridge README · Browser tools：The 27 `browser_*` tools cover page text, structured snapshots, screenshots, clicks, hovering, typing, keys, scrolling, selection, navigation, waits, uploads, downloads, dialogs, and explicit tab ownership. Screenshot results are images and require a model with image support.

dsh-browser-bridge README · Browser tools：Every operation targets an explicit tab handle. DSH separates ownership by Agent/Session; Antigravity separates it by MCP process. Chats sharing one MCP process do not automatically receive separate identities. Browser internal pages and native system windows are outside the supported scope.

The bridge listens on `127.0.0.1:9224` by default. Windows state and the pairing token live in `%USERPROFILE%\.browser-bridge`. Page contents and screenshots are passed to the selected host and model.
